en: Black‑and‑white historic street view showing the facade of a multi‑storey brick and stone building with an ornate arched entrance on the left. A group of men, some in work clothes and some in coats and hats, stand in a line along the sidewalk in front of several shopfronts. Above one shop is signage for "A. Ohlsson's Speceri‑ och …", and another sign reads "A.B. Mauritz" with additional smaller text beneath. The architectural style is late‑19th‑century Northern European, and the street is paved with cobblestones.
